settings.heading: Specs stay in prose everywhere else
settings.text: Across seven cookware competitors audited on 26 Sep 2026 (Mauviel, Demeyere, HexClad, Our Place, Smithey, Made In, Borough Furnace), material architecture, dimensions, and heat-source compatibility do not appear as structured, agent-parseable fields — only in names, FAQ prose, or description HTML.

settings.heading: Agentic checkout is table stakes
settings.text: HexClad, Our Place, and Smithey already expose full UCP agentic transactions (cart, checkout, payment handlers) via Shopify’s platform default — not as brand-led catalog depth. Buying through an agent is not differentiation; understanding the pan still is.

settings.heading: The open gap is the spec layer
settings.text: Because UCP catalog responses carry no metafields, enrichment must land as JSON-LD additionalProperty on PDPs plus an agent layer that reads the versioned catalog schema directly. That is the surface we are building first.

settings.heading: Why the catalog is machine-readable
settings.lede: Maison Tavo is cookware you can live with and a catalog an agent can reason about. We do not claim to be first in agentic commerce — that bar is already Shopify platform default. The defensible claim: first in cookware to make the product spec layer machine-readable.
settings.closing: Evidence tiers on this page map to the competitor audit in the engagement docs. CONCEPT_SPEC products stay flagged as concept — no unverified performance numbers in customer-facing copy. Dual depth: the curator reads craft and provenance; the technologist reads alloy, heat sources, and structured fields.

settings.heading: Three-place texture
settings.text: Indian casting, Japanese forging, and European design language are carried as one deliberate synthesis — not borrowed prestige. The object layer of the brand stack (cookware as craft and heirloom) is what the hospitality kitchen actually holds.

settings.heading: Technologist + curator
settings.text: One surface, two reading depths: engineering specs and agent-ready data for the culinary technologist; staging, provenance, and quiet hospitality for the aesthetic curator. Nothing is deprioritized — the blend is the hospitality-chef persona.

settings.heading: Kitchen before spectacle
settings.text: Between London and Jaipur — hotel kitchens, restaurant menus, and the discipline of a well-run pass. The house opens when the edition is ready, not on a calendar of drops.

settings.heading: Maison Tavo
settings.lede: Modern heirlooms for the working kitchen. Kartavya Jharwal builds the brand as object, software layer, and protocol — cookware, intelligent companion surfaces, and agent-native commerce in one MECE stack.
settings.closing: This storefront is designed and developed at kartavya.tech. The house itself remains a product house for food.
